levels.detail: Correct the cemetery composition: REMOVE the large crypt doorway and its left-side stone building entirely. Replace that area with receding graveyard scenery behind the route. No mausoleum entrance, stairs, wall, tree trunk, gate or foreground grave may block either end or the walkable lane. Retain crooked gravestones, dead trees, fog, moonlit distant ruined castle and tiny warm grave candles behind/below the route. Make it a through-cemetery, not a path ending at a crypt.

levels.title: Přehrada zepředu — v2
levels.description: Přímý pohled na hráz, vodorovná cesta po její koruně zprava doleva.
levels.detail: Recompose the dam from a DIRECT FRONTAL SIDE-ELEVATION view: its long concrete front wall lies parallel to the image plane, spans beyond BOTH edges, and drops vertically below a straight horizontal dam crest. The TOP OF THE DAM is the walkable path, at about 55 percent image height, with only a narrow visible top-surface strip. The crest runs ruler-straight horizontally from the right edge to the left edge at a single height, without perspective convergence, curve, slope, turn or tunnel. NO three-quarter or isometric view. Show the monumental weathered cracked concrete face and spillways BELOW the walking line; the wooded mountains, reservoir and sky remain distant scenery ABOVE/BEHIND it. Sparse back-edge rusty guard rails are fine, but no foreground railing that hides walking characters, no control building on the route and no gaps obstructing the path. Preserve the original dam's distressed concrete, moss, muted daylight and illustrative style.

levels.title: Sídliště zepředu — v2
levels.description: Čelní fasáda paneláku a rovná vodorovná ulice napříč celým obrazem.
levels.detail: Recompose as a DIRECT FRONT VIEW of the broad flat facade of one long Czech prefabricated apartment block (panelak), parallel to the image plane and extending past both sides. The facade fills the background, with weathered concrete panels, windows, three useful balcony groups, pipes and a recessed entrance; retain the original rundown residential character and daylight palette. In front of it, a straight horizontal sidewalk and asphalt street cross the FULL image width at about 75-85 percent image height, perfectly level and parallel to the bottom edge. The street continues freely off BOTH edges. No corner of a foreground building, no road receding into the distance, no central courtyard perspective. Place bins/bench/vegetation back against the facade, outside the open traversable street. A flush manhole cover is acceptable, not a giant blocking hole. No cars or barriers blocking edge entry/exit.

levels.name: Střecha paneláku
levels.title: Nekončící střecha — v2
levels.description: Střecha i fasáda pokračují vlevo a vpravo mimo obraz, bez bočního konce budovy.
levels.detail: Make a precise composition correction while preserving the rooftop scene as much as possible: EXTEND THE ROOF AND FRONT BUILDING FACADE BEYOND BOTH LEFT AND RIGHT IMAGE EDGES. Remove the visible right-hand END/CORNER of the building, its perpendicular side parapet and end ladder. There must be NO visible end wall, side edge, roof corner, gap or drop at either lateral border. The front roof edge is a perfectly horizontal line across the FULL width around 65 percent image height. Continue the same tar rooftop walking surface and weathered concrete facade/window rhythm offscreen both ways. The rear parapet likewise continues horizontally off both edges. Keep the moody city skyline, distant hills, chimneys, rooftop access hut, antennas, windblown rag and weathered puddled materials. Keep rooftop equipment against the BACK edge, leaving the full-width foreground walking strip unobstructed. Camera straight at front facade, no right side wall. Do not turn this into a bridge; it is the middle section of an indefinitely long apartment building rooftop.
